When can I swap out of Hollow Palm?
Whenever you find a Quarterstaff that increases your DPS.
If you're unsure, simply equip any potential upgrade, and check the DPS of your main skill in the Gem Menu (Default Hotkey: G).

To clear quickly, dodge rolling and running between packs of enemies is required. If aggressive play is difficult to execute, avoid dodge rolling into enemies, and attempt to off-screen enemies with

from a distance; allowing the projectiles to Chain and Fork to clear the pack. That said, during Atlas progression, some enemies, such as Abyss Mobs can be quite challenging, you need high damage and coverage in these scenarios to clear efficiently.
Upgrading your item bases for more base Energy Shield or Evasion: prioritising your Body Armour, Helmet, and Boots.
Allocating additional % increased Maximum Energy Shield, % increased Evasion Rating, or Gain Deflection Rating on the Passive Tree
In Path of Exile 2: increased Rarity of Items Found also increases the chance to upgrade currency to
. The effect is so massive, that playing without it, is arguably an egregious error. That said, there are roughly two breakpoints to aim for at the minimum:
100% IIR: During Early Maps, when items with tons of IIR are hard to find.
150% IIR: Needs to be achieved ASAP, moving from 100% to 150% IIR is a significant upgrade.

After, 150%+ IIR, there appears to be severe diminishing returns. However, some players argues that the marginal gains at higher amounts of IIR are worth it, if accompanied with large amounts of playtime.

Acquiring Aspirational Gear is a long journey, requiring lots of juiced map farming, trading, and optionally crafting for profit. Depending on your experience and available playtime, achieving it may be a league-long goal.
That said, your primary goals are:
Highest EDPS or PDPS Talisman you can afford, with 15%+ Crit,
When purchasing from the Trade Site, many Weapons have higher DPS because they are socketed with
Maintain 150%+ IIR or as close as possible
Instill your Amulet with Zarohk's Gift and Craft a New Jewel
Spirit of the Stag for Movement Speed, Skill Speed, and Gain Extra Lightning Damage
Spirit of the Cat for Movement Speed, Skill Speed, Critical Hit Chance and Evasion Rating
Spirit of the Wolf for Movement Speed, Skill Speed, and Armour Break
Spirit of the Owl for Increased Energy Shield, Increased Damage, Gain Damage as Extra Cold (Low Prio)
Spirit of the Bear for Increased Maximum Life, Increased Stun Threshold, Increased Stun Buildup, and Reduced Damage Taken (Low Prio)
